description: This line plot illustrates the loss values for two models, “Vanilla” and “SepLLM,” as a function of computational cost measured in TFLOPs. The x-axis represents TFLOPs, ranging from 0.00 to 1.25 × 10⁹, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.25, and is labeled “TFLOPs.” The y-axis represents “Loss,” ranging from 2.40 to 2.75, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05, and is labeled “Loss.” The “Vanilla” model is represented by a purple line with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreasing to approximately 2.50 at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. The “SepLLM” model is represented by a red line with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreasing to approximately 2.46 at 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. A green dashed horizontal line marks a loss value of 2.50, which both lines cross at approximately 1.0 × 10⁹ TFLOPs. A green dashed box highlights the region from 1.0 × 10⁹ to 1.25 × 10⁹ TFLOPs, with a label “1.28×” indicating a 1.28x increase in TFLOPs over that interval.
